Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The record names the domain/persona/problem context. The vignettes add that context is also structural and local: "I can only affirm in context. When I see a statement, I need to see whats next to it. And what contains it" (4fd551ad); "i need to see what is linked to what and be able to see the link before I can reliably affirm" (7c963e02); affirm "right next to where I write" (67459d40); affirmations should sit next to the conversations that generated them (ef16e77c). Also adds distance in time and place: a chat session makes affirmation abstract (81f2bf49); context is lost by the time affirmation happens (f6846947); approving a connection without seeing it in context (b7372574). Tensions are hardest (7d3a1ea0). Consequence beyond a click: becoming "a click monkey affirming things I can't review" (23f12a6f), clicking "recommended" (8b5b80d6), and a drift toward a confidence level instead of pure affirmation (1110c523). An affirmation "only exists within that context" (a2225a2a).

**Proposed.** I can only affirm a record in its context: what sits next to it, what contains it, what it links to, and the conversation it came from. Affirmation arrives as a flat queue, away from where I wrote and after the context has gone, so I cannot see what I am affirming, and I end up clicking accept on things I cannot review.

**Depth.** Deep: 14 vignettes, strongly recurring, with several near-restatements of the same pain; clear persistent frustration still unresolved ("I still cannot properly work out how to manage affirmations").

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
